#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the AMP Nimbus instance template.
# Resolves a Nimbus release and installs the requested components out of it.
# The release zip lays out release_full/Nimbus (proxy), release_full/Nimbus.Registry
# (standalone registry) and release_full/Nimbus.ServerMod (the Vintage Story mod).
set -euo pipefail

root="${1:?root directory required}"
components="${2:?component list required}"
cd "$root"

repo="StratumServer/Nimbus"
hdr=(-H "User-Agent: AMP-Nimbus-Template" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then hdr+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"); fi

for tool in curl unzip jq; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[AMP] $tool is required but not installed" >&2; exit 1; }
done

tag="$(printf '%s' "${NIMBUS_TAG:-}" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$tag" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] resolving Nimbus release (channel=${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable})"
  json="$(curl -fsSL "${hdr[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=100")"
  filter='.[] | select(.draft == false)'
  if [ "${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable}" != "prerelease" ]; then
    filter="${filter} | select(.prerelease == false)"
  fi
  tag="$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r "[ ${filter} ] | .[0].tag_name // empty")"
fi
[ -n "$tag" ] || { echo "[AMP] no Nimbus release matched channel=${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable}" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$tag" in v*) ;; *) tag="v${tag}";; esac

marker=".amp-nimbus-release"
if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ "$(cat "$marker")" = "$tag" ]; then
  ok=1
  for comp in $components; do
    [ -d "$comp" ] || ok=0
  done
  if [ "$ok" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[AMP] already on Nimbus ${tag}; nothing to download"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

url="https://github.com/${repo}/releases/download/${tag}/Nimbus-${tag}.zip"
echo "[AMP] downloading ${url}"
rm -rf .nimbus-extract
mkdir -p .nimbus-extract
curl -fL --retry 3 -o nimbus-release.zip "$url"
unzip -qo nimbus-release.zip -d .nimbus-extract
rm -f nimbus-release.zip

src=".nimbus-extract/release_full"
[ -d "$src" ] || src=".nimbus-extract"

for comp in $components; do
  if [ ! -d "$src/$comp" ]; then
    echo "[AMP] component $comp is not present in this release" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  mkdir -p "$comp"
  # Config, state and plugins live in the component directory, so replace program files
  # only and leave everything the operator or Nimbus itself wrote in place.
  find "$comp" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.dll' -o -name '*.pdb' -o -name '*.deps.json' \
    -o -name '*.runtimeconfig.json' -o -name 'web.config' -o -name '*.staticwebassets.endpoints.json' \) -delete
  cp -RL "$src/$comp/." "$comp/"
done

if [ -f "Nimbus/Nimbus.Proxy" ]; then chmod +x "Nimbus/Nimbus.Proxy"; fi
if [ -f "Nimbus.Registry/Nimbus.Registry" ]; then chmod +x "Nimbus.Registry/Nimbus.Registry"; fi
if [ -f "$src/LICENSE" ]; then cp -f "$src/LICENSE" ./LICENSE; fi

rm -rf .nimbus-extract
printf '%s' "$tag" > "$marker"
echo "[AMP] installed Nimbus ${tag} (${components}) into ${root}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Renders nimbus.registry.toml from environment variables set by AMP.
# Generated by the AMP Nimbus instance template; edits here are overwritten on the next update.
set -uf

OUT="${1:-}"
if [ -z "$OUT" ]; then echo "usage: $0 <output-path>" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ "$(printf '%s' "${NR_WRITE:-true}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" != "true" ]; then
  echo "AMP management of $(basename "$OUT") is disabled, leaving the existing file alone"
  exit 0
fi

TMP="$OUT.amptmp"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
: > "$TMP"

esc() { printf '%s' "${1-}" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g'; }
bl() { case "$(printf '%s' "${1-}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" in true|1|yes|on) printf 'true';; *) printf 'false';; esac }
num() { case "${1-}" in ''|*[!0-9-]*) printf '%s' "${2-0}";; *) printf '%s' "$1";; esac }
trim() { printf '%s' "${1-}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//'; }
lst() {
  local out="" first=1 x
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else out="$out, "; fi
    out="$out\"$(esc "$x")\""
  done
  printf '[%s]' "$out"
}
srv() {
  local x k v
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    case "$x" in *=*) ;; *) echo "skipping malformed servers entry '$x' (expected id=host:port)" >&2; continue;; esac
    k="$(trim "${x%%=*}")"; v="$(trim "${x#*=}")"
    if [ -z "$k" ] || [ -z "$v" ]; then
      echo "skipping malformed servers entry '$x' (expected id=host:port)" >&2
      continue
    fi
    printf '"%s" = "%s"\n' "$(esc "$k")" "$(esc "$v")" >> "$TMP"
  done
}
fh() {
  local x k v
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    case "$x" in *=*) ;; *) echo "skipping malformed forced_hosts entry '$x' (expected hostname=id1|id2)" >&2; continue;; esac
    k="$(trim "${x%%=*}")"; v="$(trim "${x#*=}")"
    [ -z "$k" ] && continue
    printf '"%s" = %s\n' "$(esc "$k")" "$(lst "$(printf '%s' "$v" | tr '|' ',')")" >> "$TMP"
  done
}
mods() {
  local out="" first=1 x k v
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    case "$x" in
      *=*) k="$(trim "${x%%=*}")"; v="$(trim "${x#*=}")";;
      *) k="$x"; v="";;
    esac
    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else out="$out, "; fi
    out="$out{ id = \"$(esc "$k")\", version = \"$(esc "$v")\" }"
  done
  printf '[%s]' "$out"
}
keep_secret() {
  local key="$1" val="${2:-}" f="$3" cur=""
  if [ -n "$val" ]; then printf '%s' "$val"; return; fi
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    cur="$(sed -n "s/^[[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\(.*\)\".*/\1/p" "$f" | head -n 1)"
    case "$cur" in
      ""|change-me-and-keep-secret) ;;
      *) printf '%s' "$cur"; return;;
    esac
  fi
  echo "[AMP] no ${key} set, generating a random one; read it out of $(basename "$f") and paste it into every backend" >&2
  head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'
}
printf 'bind_url = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_BIND:-http://0.0.0.0:8765}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'shared_secret = "%s"\n' "$(esc "$(keep_secret shared_secret "${NR_SECRET:-}" "$OUT")")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'accepted_secrets = %s\n' "$(lst "${NR_ACCEPTED:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'backend_stale_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_STALE:-20}" 20)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'backend_drop_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_DROP:-120}" 120)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'nonce_window_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_NONCE:-90}" 90)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'max_reservation_ttl_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_MAXRESTTL:-300}" 300)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'log_heartbeats = %s\n' "$(bl "${NR_LOGHB:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'state_dir = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_STATEDIR:-.}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[api_tokens]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'enabled = %s\n' "$(bl "${NR_APITOK:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'rate_limit_per_minute = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_APIRATE:-60}" 60)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'trust_forwarded_proto = %s\n' "$(bl "${NR_APIFWD:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[identity]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'advertise_on_master_server = %s\n' "$(bl "${NR_I_ADVERTISE:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'master_server_url = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_MSURL:-http://masterserver.vintagestory.at/api/v1/servers/}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'public_host = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_HOST:-127.0.0.1}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'public_port = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_I_PORT:-42420}" 42420)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'server_name = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_NAME:-Nimbus Network}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'server_description = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_DESC:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'server_url = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_URL:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'server_icon = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_ICON:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'vh_identifier = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_VHID:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'game_version = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_GAMEVER:-1.22.2}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'max_players_override = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_I_MAXPLAYERS:-0}" 0)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'mod_source = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_MODSOURCE:-aggregate}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'explicit_mods = %s\n' "$(mods "${NR_I_MODS:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'whitelisted = %s\n' "$(bl "${NR_I_WHITELISTED:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'has_password = %s\n' "$(bl "${NR_I_HASPASSWORD:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'heartbeat_interval_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NR_I_HB:-120}" 120)" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[identity.playstyle]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'id = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_PSID:-surviveandbuild}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'lang_code = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NR_I_PSLANG:-preset-surviveandbuild}")" >> "$TMP"
mv -f "$TMP" "$OUT"
echo "wrote $OUT"
